commitBehavior.description: Select what action the commit button will perform in the Git status panel
commitBehavior.commitDescription: Only commits files in stage. Does not sync with remote repository.
commitBehavior.commitPushDescription: Commits and then sends changes to remote repository. Does not download changes from remote.
commitBehavior.commitSyncDescription: Commits, downloads changes from remote (fetch + pull) and then sends local changes (push). Fully syncs with remote repository.
